## ⬇️ Download

**[MixCoach.zip](https://github.com/xeewi/mixcoach/releases/latest/download/MixCoach.zip)** — for Ableton Live 12 (Suite, or Standard + Max for Live), macOS & Windows.

1. Copy the `MixCoach` folder to your User Library → `Presets/Audio Effects/Max Audio Effect/`
   (macOS: `~/Music/Ableton/User Library`, Windows: `Documents\Ableton\User Library`)
2. *(optional, but magic)* copy `MixCoachAuto` to `User Library/Remote Scripts/`, restart Live and pick **MixCoachAuto** as a Control Surface: sensors add themselves to every track
3. Otherwise drop **MixCoach Sensor** on each track and **MixCoach** on the Master, then press play

Full guide (EN/FR) in `INSTALL.txt` inside the zip.
